findings.evidence: Lines 89 and 235 already use independent `{k : Type u} {G : Type v}`; the proof at line 173 invokes the now universe-polymorphic `FDRep.finrank_hom_resFDRep`, while `ClassFunction.characterPairing` is likewise declared with separate universes in `CharacterTable/Pairing.lean`.
findings.fix: Change the Characters section signature to `{k : Type u} {G : Type v}` so all five character corollaries expose the same natural universe generality.
findings.issue: The shared `{k G : Type u}` still forces one universe for `frobenius_reciprocity`, `characterPairing_indFDRep`, `characterPairing_resFDRep`, `frobenius_reciprocity_resFDRep`, and `card_inv_mul_sum_character_indFDRep`, although their newly generalized dimension input and all class-function operations support independent universes.

summary: The universe generalization stops before the character-level reciprocity API, leaving its main corollaries unnecessarily restricted.
